content: pkgdown offline execution: articles execute at build time via knitr. For offline safety: use bundled data() datasets (LazyData: true), set.seed() in setup chunks. Packages needed only for website articles go in Config/Needs/website in DESCRIPTION (not Suggests). The r-lib setup-r-dependencies action reads Config/Needs/website when 'needs: website' is specified. pkgdown lazy caching (lazy=TRUE default in build_site): only rebuilds articles newer than output — helps CI performance. For CI: install packages via Config/Needs/website, ensure all article dependencies are CRAN-available or listed there. No network calls at knitr eval time for offline-safe articles.
